notes: All tiers here use standard HUNL; not the legacy Botzone simple referee.
Mixtures sample t proportional to iteration once per player per hand.
An explicit guard override evaluates a mask-modified mixture, not the archived training policy or a retrained agent.
Guard overrides affect the hero only, except health self-play where both players use the override.
Latest single archive is sigma_T (pre-fit), not post-fit theta_T.
Rule opponents are reproducible heuristics, not a local best response.
Intervals are pointwise; no guarantee of monotonic CFR improvement.
Thresholds are experimental targets from Test.md, not certified GTO ranges.

self_improvement.reason: T=1000 vs T=100; >=2500 pairs, mean>=35, CI lower>0 mbb/hand

repo_baseline.reason: Requires a rule-compatible PPO/conv baseline and paired CI lower>0

slumbot.reason: Requires >=5000 external 200BB hands, CI and off-tree telemetry

behavior.reason: 10000 self-play hands; SB open shove<1.5%; zero illegal/NaN/Inf

sandbox.reason: Evaluation PyTorch process is not a Botzone deployment artifact; packaged CPU sandbox still required
